answer: Hardware enclave attestation resists Sybil attacks by binding each agent to a tamper-proof processor. An attestation lantern audits signed hardware proofs to block cloned virtual machines. Scaling fake identities requires purchasing dedicated silicon, forcing attackers to incur linear equipment costs instead of repurposing an obsolete relic or forging a jade access key. However, this architecture relies on trusted chip foundries and remains vulnerable to side-channel exploits.
